item.title: Trump announces Hamas to disarm paving way for Israel to withdraw from Gaza
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on TruthSocial that an agreement has been reached for Hamas to fully disarm.

item.title: UK left-wing MP Diane Abbott reinstated by Labour Party after suspension
item.description: Diane Abbott returns to Labour, a year after her suspension over comments about racism.

item.title: Pathirage challenges Chopra-Nadeem javelin rivalry in Commonwealth final
item.description: Sri Lanka's Rumesh Pathirage is favourite ahead of rivalry between India's Neeraj Chopra and Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem.

item.title: US appeals court rejects Trump expansion of mandatory migrant detention
item.description: Appeals court rules that the Trump administration cannot deny detained migrants the chance for release on bond.

item.title: Trump administration appeals to never-before-used court for deportation
item.description: US government prosecutors are seeking the removal of Nazira Haji Zada, though she faces no criminal charges.

item.title: Trump says Board of Peace reaches agreement on disarmament of Hamas in Gaza
item.description: US president says Israel will withdraw from Gaza following the disarmament of Hamas.

item.title: Amazon’s Zoox secures US federal approval for steering-wheel-free robotaxis
item.description: Zoox will launch its commercial robotaxi service in Las Vegas after receiving federal clearance.

item.title: Why is US GDP growth slowing, and how can it be reversed?
item.description: Tariffs and oil price hikes create a supply shock, dragging down US economic growth in the second quarter of 2026.

item.title: French teen fined in Singapore over ‘straw licking’ stunt
item.description: A French teenager has been fined about $465 after pleading guilty to a public nuisance charge in Singapore.

item.title: Argentina’s Milei seeks to deport foreigners that spread ‘hate’ of country
item.description: Experts have cast doubt on legality of the emergency decree as Milei decries a campaign of 'hostility' after World Cup.

item.title: Will Saudi Arabia be dragged further into the war in Iran?
item.description: Anger in Iraq after US-Saudi strikes on paramilitary group with ties to Tehran.

item.title: Prague Zoo keeps polar bears cool with ice amid heatwave
item.description: Keepers at Prague Zoo used tonnes of ice to provide much relief to animals as Europe grappled with scorching heat.

item.title: UN launches hunt for next chief amid rising challenges
item.description: Antonio Guterres’s successor will be tasked with revitalising an organisation in crisis and facing pressure to reform.

item.title: Security camera shows ‘Russian missile’ exploding in Poland
item.description: Security camera video shows the moment a suspected Russian missile exploded inside Poland.

item.title: Father of Georgia Apalachee school shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
item.description: Colin Gray, 55, was convicted of second-degree murder after his son Colt carried out a school shooting that killed four.

item.title: US authorities probe cyberattack on water systems in Minnesota
item.description: A cyberattack targeted more than 30 water facilities in the Midwestern US state earlier this week.

item.title: Palestine Action co-founder wins UK Supreme Court appeal bid
item.description: Huda Ammori has won permission to challenge Palestine Action's ban at the UK Supreme Court.

item.title: Pakistan coal mine explosion kills at least 32 miners
item.description: Accidents common in Pakistan’s coal mining industry, particularly in Balochistan, where many mines lack basic safety.

item.title: Saudi Arabia announces maritime defence alliance to secure vital waterways
item.description: Fourteen nations sign up to alliance to protect vital trade and energy routes amid escalating hostilities.

item.title: Congo’s Ebola death toll passes 1,500 as it struggles to halt spread
item.description: There's still no vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain of the virus as the country struggles for control in infected areas.

item.title: UN demands end of Ugandan clampdown on dissent
item.description: Pervasive climate of fear condemned amid human rights violations and crackdowns on opposition.

item.title: ABC News says FCC is carrying out intimidation campaign to shape coverage
item.description: Trump administration has frequently sought to pressure companies over coverage critical of the president and his allies.

item.title: Spain’s Ceuta declares emergency over surge in migrant arrivals
item.description: More than 1,500 migrants have reached Spain’s North African enclave of Ceuta by sea over the past week.

item.title: Turtle rescued from rubble a month after Venezuela earthquake
item.description: A turtle who survived for over a month under the rubble of a collapsed building following Venezuela’s earthquake rescued

item.title: Viral cricket scandal sees ‘Clicky Ponting’ suspended from UK team
item.description: Viral cricket scandal sees 'Clicky Ponting' suspended from UK team
